excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: I believe we have two options: (1) Define a new `MAX_DEPOSIT_REQUESTS_PER_PAYLOAD_GLOAS` set to a higher value (say 1 million) and use this value in the payload checks. (2) Simply remove `MAX_DEPOSIT_REQUESTS_PER_PAYLOAD` by marking it as deprecated in Gloas; then we remove the `assert len(requests.deposits) <= MAX_DEPOSIT_REQUESTS_PER_PAYLOAD` check in `apply_parent_execution_payload`.

excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content: Deposits are different than the other requests (withdrawals, consolidations, etc). In my opinion, it doesn't really make sense to have a defined maximum in the CL as we cannot queue them & it's already limited by the EL's gas limit.
